description: This Java class implements a mail container for the Apache OFBiz framework, managing email retrieval via JavaMail API, including session creation, store connection, message polling, and processing.

classes.name: JavaMailContainer
classes.description: Main class implementing a mail container for email polling and processing within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: LoggingStoreListener
classes.description: Implements StoreListener to log mail store events.

classes.name: PollerTask
classes.description: Runnable task that polls email messages from configured mail stores, processes unread messages, and handles message flags.

classes.name: MimeMessageWrapper
classes.description: Referenced in processMessage method; wraps MimeMessage for rule evaluation (assumed to be a utility class).

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with commands, name, and config file.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the mail polling service, sets up sessions, stores, and scheduled polling.

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Creates a JavaMail Session from configuration properties.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Obtains and tests a mail Store connection.

methods.name: updateUrlName
methods.description: Constructs a URLName with proper credentials and host info.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main polling loop that checks messages from all configured stores.

methods.name: checkMessages
methods.description: Fetches and processes unread email messages from a store.

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Processes individual email messages, invoking rule evaluation.
